Expected 1.0 deterministically on same-status body-only AvsC (31 vs 117) and AvsB (70 vs 31) where bodies differ both via CDN and BG, and 0.0 on body-null and on header-only AvsE where bodies identical 31B SHA d0ca833f; also 1.0 on classic 403/401 where bodies differ (22B 387fe7 vs 25B 9df36). Null 0.0. For gradient headers, magnitude ordering exposed via headers vs headers-no-CLEN decomposition. Isolates body-correlated vs independent header signal.

Filtered headers minus Content-Length. Expected 0.0 on same-status body-only AvsC/AvsB on CDN/BG (no independent header drift, all non-CLEN headers identical), and 1.0 on header-only AvsE and per-header isolations CC/ETag/SC; for CC_small 1s diff vs ETag 1char diff enables sensitivity ordering. Proves body-only signal not via independent header drift and header-only not via CLEN correlation. Critical isolation for CDN decompression/body_len vs header truth.
